title: Synthia Research Mesh Canon Seed

sources.origin: Library: On the Architecture of Proportion of Perspective / SPEC-2 Klein Tool
claims: Meaning is proportional to position; once a position is evaluated, its reading is fixed to that exact position.
The operative substrate is one shared structure with knowledge, state, temporal/associative and causal/dependency properties rather than isolated duplicate graphs.
Klein Tools are context-dependent emergent behavior primitives. Their output is relation, intensity and direction.
A Klein Tool must not return a context-independent fixed relation.
Joint evaluation must generate the combined result from co-active context, not by summing individually evaluated outputs.
The same exact context must resolve deterministically after collapse.

sources.origin: Library: Pure Synthia recursive generative state calculus
claims: Pure Synthia is a recursively addressed deterministic automata system.
The same reusable relational operators should be testable across linguistic, semantic, computational and multi-automata scales.
Every learned or candidate rule carries support, confidence, error and provenance.
Emergence means a higher-order configuration is generated from registered lower-order states and permitted operators rather than stored as a finished solution.

sources.origin: Drive: Intelligent Research Book / AutoNovel design
claims: Research is the primary identity; coding and compilation are supporting research functions.
Supported research sources include arXiv, PubMed, GitHub, Hugging Face, official documentation, uploaded files, local collections and custom websites.
AUTOLING, DISEMINER, MESSY, Language Contact Model and AUTONOVEL should operate as coordinated mechanisms over a shared state-space.

Research integrity requires source material, direct evidence, observations, interpretations, generated explanations, hypotheses, assumptions, contradictions, unresolved questions and verified conclusions to remain distinguishable.
AUTONOVEL produces extended explanations and structured research narratives from registered evidence and state.

hard_invariants: Everything entering Synthia is automatically registered at intake.
Never silently rename, merge, omit, relocate, simplify or refactor an existing canonical component.
Unknown architecture is preserved as unresolved, not normalized.
Evidence and generated interpretation are stored as different object types.
Klein relations are generated from active context.
Resolved Klein output is deterministic for the identical context.
Coder changes are additive proposals until explicitly promoted.
